title: After the Vale barrow's stone doors were already opened via the priest's blessing, the hunter at the hunter's camp still describes 'a gap under a fallen stone on the north face if you'd rather not test the doors' as a live alternative, though the doors were already open and the barrow already resolved by the time I heard it.
where: Vale / Hunter's Camp, ask hunter: the old barrow
